description: Design registry for curated pre-generated Mister F scene images.

images.title: Lost Wallet At The Cafe

characters.description: Young Latina woman in a yellow raincoat with a shoulder bag.
Older Black man in a green jacket returning a wallet.

panelSequence: The woman enters the cafe from the rain.
Her wallet falls from her bag near the door.
The man notices the wallet and picks it up.
The man returns the wallet and the woman looks relieved.
pedagogicalPromptIdeas: Describe what happens in each panel.
Write a short story about the lost wallet.
What should the man do next?
How does the woman feel? Why?
images.generationPrompt: Create a square four-panel wordless comic illustration for an English-learning activity. The image should be a clean 2x2 comic grid with four equal panels and simple gutters. Read order should be left to right, top to bottom. Do not label the panels. Story: a simple lost-and-found story in a cozy cafe on a rainy afternoon. A young Latina woman in a yellow raincoat enters the cafe with a shoulder bag. She accidentally drops her brown wallet near the entrance. An older Black man in a green jacket notices the wallet and picks it up. He returns it to her, and she looks relieved and grateful. Panel 1: the young woman enters the cafe from the rain, holding her shoulder bag and looking for a table. Panel 2: the wallet slips from the open bag and falls near the door while she walks away unaware. Panel 3: the older man sees the wallet on the floor, bends down, and picks it up. Panel 4: the older man gives the wallet back to the woman; she smiles with relief and thanks him with friendly body language. Style: clean 2D cartoon illustration matching modern English workbook art and the Mister F roleplay avatars: rounded expressive characters, crisp outlines, bright natural colors, light simple shading, friendly educational tone, polished but not overly detailed. Strict constraints: no readable text anywhere in the image. No letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, logos, menus, signs, labels, posters, readable writing on papers, panel numbers, or watermarks.
qaNotes: Designed as a four-panel wordless cafe lost-and-found story.

images.title: Shared Umbrella At The Bus Stop

characters.description: Teenage boy with medium-brown skin, curly hair, a blue hoodie, and a backpack.
Middle-aged woman with light skin, short gray hair, a red coat, and an umbrella.

panelSequence: The boy waits at a rainy bus stop.
The rain gets heavier and he realizes he has no umbrella.
The woman shares her umbrella with him.
They walk toward the bus together.
pedagogicalPromptIdeas: Describe the weather in each panel.
Write a story about the bus stop.
How does the boy feel in panel two?
What does the woman do to help?
